# Admetus Lifesciences

> Admetus Lifesciences is a precision softgel capsule manufacturer based in Haryana, India. Founded in 2020 by Mr. Anudeep Deswal, the company specializes in contract manufacturing, private label, and export-ready nutraceutical softgel capsules for global brand owners, distributors, and importers.

## Company

- Legal name: Admetus Lifesciences
- Founded: 2020
- Founder: Mr. Anudeep Deswal
- Manufacturing facility: Village Anta, Tehsil Safidon, District Jind, Haryana 126112, India
- Business type: B2B nutraceutical softgel capsule manufacturer
- Capabilities: Contract manufacturing, private label, custom formulation, export
- Workforce: 90%+ women from rural Haryana villages
- Equipment: ARBES SGX-806P soft gelatin encapsulation line, Elmach EPI 2000 blister packing machine
- Certifications: FSSAI, GMP, HACCP, Halal, WHO-GMP

- [Vitamin D3 60K IU Stability Challenge](https://www.admetuslifesciences.com/case-studies/vitamin-d3-stability-challenge/): Illustrative scenario showing how a stability concern was resolved in 6 weeks through active overage, drying optimization, and PVDC blister upgrade

## Product Catalog (10 Softgel Formulations)

### Calcium & Bone Health
- [Calcitriol + Calcium + K2-7](https://www.admetuslifesciences.com/products/calcitriol-calcium-k27-softgel/): Advanced bone health with Vitamin K2-7 — Calcitriol, Calcium Carbonate, K2-7, B12, Zinc, Magnesium, L-Methylfolate
- [Cholecalciferol 60,000 IU](https://www.admetuslifesciences.com/products/cholecalciferol-60000-iu/): High-dose Vitamin D3 weekly therapy

### Omega & Heart Health
- [Omega-3 + Vitamin E](https://www.admetuslifesciences.com/products/omega-3-vitamin-e-softgel/): Pure fish oil for cardiovascular and brain health
- [Krill Oil](https://www.admetuslifesciences.com/products/krill-oil-softgel/): Phospholipid-bound omega-3 with natural astaxanthin

### Antioxidant & Multivitamin
- [Ginseng + Astaxanthin Multi](https://www.admetuslifesciences.com/products/ginseng-astaxanthin-multivitamin/): Premium energy and vitality complex
- [Glutathione + ALA + Grape Seed](https://www.admetuslifesciences.com/products/glutathione-ala-grape-seed/): Advanced skin and antioxidant formula
- [Lycopene + Grape Seed Multi](https://www.admetuslifesciences.com/products/lycopene-grape-seed-multivitamin/): Potent antioxidant multimineral blend

### Women's Health
- [Isoflavones + Calcium + D3](https://www.admetuslifesciences.com/products/isoflavones-calcium-vitamin-d3/): Complete women's bone and hormonal support

### Men's Health
- [Ginkgo + Tribulus Vitality](https://www.admetuslifesciences.com/products/ginkgo-tribulus-mens-vitality/): Men's performance and vitality formula

### Herbal & Specialty
- [Nigella Sativa (Kalonji)](https://www.admetuslifesciences.com/products/nigella-sativa-kalonji/): Traditional black seed oil softgel

## Key Facts for Buyers

- Minimum order quantities (MOQ): Flexible based on formulation and packaging
- Lead time: Quote within 48 hours of inquiry
- Sample policy: Samples available on approval after specifications confirmed
- Packaging options: Blister packs, bottles, custom carton designs
- Documentation: Full batch documentation, Certificate of Analysis (COA), regulatory support for export
- Facility audits: Welcomed for partnership evaluation
- Production process: Raw material sourcing → formulation → encapsulation → drying → quality inspection → blister packing → final packing & dispatch
